user_prompt: We need to integrate our reservation system with our accounts payable workflow so that no-show fees are automatically flagged in our ERP and matched against vendor contracts to determine if we should dispute the charge or pay it based on our negotiated terms.

steps.step_name: Integrate our reservation system with our accounts payable workflow to automatically flag no-show fees in our ERP
Match no-show fees against vendor contracts to retrieve negotiated terms and dispute policies
Determine whether to dispute or pay flagged charges based on our negotiated contract terms

intent_resolver.reason: This request requires integration between reservation management, accounts payable, ERP systems, and vendor contract analysis—a cross-system financial reconciliation workflow that doesn't match any of the registered skills, which focus on manufacturing, product launches, procurement, and operational
